description: As part of the Limited Edition UD Jean-Michel Basquiat collection, the Tenant Eyeshadow Palette by Urban Decay features eight exclusive bright shades inspired by the work of this groundbreaking artist. From the colors and shade names to the packaging, everything in this collection evolved from Basquiat's art. Like Urban Decay, Basquiat was an outsider who challenged the status quo and used color in nontraditional ways. From his informal graffiti work and the way he mixed mediums and colors to the way he spoke out against social injustice, it's hard to imagine a more perfect fit for UD. The Tenant Eyeshadow Palette contains eight just-dreamed-up brights based on Basquiat's paintings. Every shade features UD's proprietary Pigment Infusion System - for rich, velvety, blendable color that lasts. There's even a small cutout on the back for hanging so you can display the palette on your wall and create your own mini Basquiat gallery. About the artist: Jean-Michel Basquiat began drawing and painting at the age of four and never stopped. By the time he was in his teens, his graffiti was a fixture around lower Manhattan. After leaving home at 17, he began selling hand-painted postcards and T-shirts. At 20, he landed his first public exhibition and quickly rose to fame on the '80s art scene in NYC. His iconic work is still exhibited all over the world. Barry M Cosmetics was created in 1982, in London, Great Britain, by Barry Mero.

In the early 80's Barry had a number of retail outlets in London selling beauty and cosmetic products. The fashion was for dramatic, outrageous make-up, however, he found that no one was producing the exciting and vivid colors that his customers really wanted. So, in June 1982, he created the Barry M Cosmetics range.

Barry M soon became a cult name in the field of color cosmetics. Back in those days, if you were a new romantic, a punk or goth, the chances are you would have been using Barry M to make your fashion statement!

Now, many years' later Barry M is now the Britain's leading color cosmetics brand - other big beauty companies may claim to be British but, in fact, very few of them really are!

That's important because, when it comes to having a British heritage and a British eye for color and style, we're proud to be True Brits. And we're proud to offer our customers a unique mix of high quality, cruelty-free, on trend products at affordable prices.

description:
HOW TO BUY EYESHADOW

Build a custom eyeshadow palette that includes highlighting, contouring, and variety of textures and finishes.

PLACEMENT:Consider these 4 primary areas around the eye to create a custom look:

• Eyelid

• Crease

• Brow Highlight

• Outer V + Lower Lash Line

COLOR: Select a few staple colors that can go with many looks, including the transition from daytime to eveningwear.

Highlighting colors are lighter colors that can be used to accentuate features, such as the brow bone, the inner corners of the eye or the center of the lid. Most common highlighting shadows are whites, creams, vanilla, peach, and soft pinks.

Contouring colors are darker colors used to create depth or dimension, to create or enhance your crease, or to accentuate your eye shape. Common contouring shadows are browns, deep burgundy, greys, and blacks.

Adding eyeshadow with texture, such as metallic and glitters will add impact to any look.

FINISH: Beauty Junkees Cosmetics offers 3 finish types.

Matte: A matte finish creates depth and definition, as it does not reflect light. Matte eyeshadow has no sheen, luster or shine leaving you with a smooth, natural finish. You will get a more intense color payoff as matte finishes have more pigmented color. QUICK TIP: Matte finishes tend to go on patchy but using a makeup primer, some concealer and a setting powder will help to avoid an uneven finish.

Matte Pearl: Matte Pearl is a combination of a matte finish and subtle fleck of glitter leaving a soft satin finish.

Pearlized: A frosty finish without glitter leaving an iridescent and brightening effect to any eye look.

Still not sure where to begin? We understand! Beauty Junkees created a series of looks in our Quad Sets. This includes 4 eyeshadow shades with varying finishes, and instructions for eyeshadow placement. It doesn’t get any easier than this!

Tap off excess and test the color on the back of your hand to ensure you have the desired amount of pigment. Hold your chin up as you look down into your mirror and place the brush at the inner corner of your eye with the point facing toward your nose. Sweep or press color along lash line working outward to the end of the lash line. Flip the brush so the point faces upward and press. This will give you the perfect winged look.

您可以信赖的美丽品牌

저희 제품은 파라벤과 글루텐이 없으며 비건 친화적 옵션의 다양한 선택을 제공합니다. Oh! 그리고 저희는 프탈레이트, 트리클로산, 포름알데히드, 납, 탈크 등과 같은 몇 가지 다른 불쾌한 것들을 버려서 최고의 제품을 얻을 수 있도록 했습니다.


Bodyography의 가장 좋은 점 중 하나는 좋은 것을 타협하지 않고 모든 나쁜 것을 제거한다는 것입니다. 저희는 품질과 성능이 최우선 사항인 전문 화장품 라인으로 시작하여 결코 변하지 않았습니다.


어떤 제품에 도달하든 최고 품질의 성분이 각 제품의 성능, 내마모성, 전반적인 경험을 보여주기 위해 사용되었으며 그리 훌륭한 성분이 없습니다.

✓ Crease

✓ Matte Pearl: Matte Pearl is a combination of a matte finish and subtle fleck of glitter leaving a soft satin finish.

✓ Pearlized: A frosty finish without glitter leaving an iridescent and brightening effect to any eye look.

PURE PIGMENTS are ultra-fine, highly concentrated loose color powders that work to create both a soft and intense make up look. How to use: Apply your chosen pigment color to the skin, using your make up brush to gently blend to both the inner and outer corners of the eye. If blending shades together, apply the first pigment color to the skin, covering the entire eyelid and blending out. Apply the second color with a clean brush, starting at the outer corner of the eye. Move the brush in small circles blending inwards for a unified finish. For a more intense look, apply a layer of color straight away and for a wash of color, apply the pigments after 2-3 minutes.

Ein schimmernder weißer flüssiger Lidschatten... mit einem Geheimnis. Was in einem Schleier aus weißem Funkeln beginnt, verwandelt sich magisch in leuchtende, ausdrucksstarke Pastelltöne, die auf den Deckeln leuchten. Es gibt zwei Seiten für jede Geschichte und es ist die gleiche mit Stilas Trickster, transformative Technologie. Auf den ersten Blick erscheint dieser schimmernde flüssige Schatten weiß. Aber die Formel enthält leuchtende Partikel mit einem farbigen Innenkern, der beim Vermischen diese inneren Kernfarben offenbart. Wie Stilas andere nicht-transfer, funkelnde flüssige Lidschatten hat diese neue Formel ein erfrischendes Gefühl, eine glatte Farbverteilung und Haut-Conditioner für ein angenehmes Gefühl.

Uma sombra líquida brilhante ... com um segredo. O que começa em um véu de brilho branco magicamente se transforma em tons luminosos e intensos inspirados em pastel que brilham nas tampas. Existem dois lados em cada história e é o mesmo que a tecnologia transformadora de Stila. À primeira vista, esta sombra líquida brilhante parece branca. Mas a fórmula contém partículas luminescentes com um núcleo interno colorido, que, quando misturado, revela as cores internas do núcleo. Como outras sombras líquidas brilhantes e não transferidas da Stila, esta nova fórmula tem uma sensação refrescante, disposição de cor suave e condicionadores de pele para uma sensação confortável.

一个闪闪发光的白色液体眼影...有一个秘密。 从白色亮片面纱开始,神奇地变成发光,尖锐的柔和色调,在盖子上闪闪发光。 每个故事都有两面，与 Stila 的魔力师变革技术相同。 一眼,一眼看着这款闪闪发光的液体眼影是白色。 但配方含有带有彩色内核的发光颗粒,混合后会显示那些内核颜色。 与 Stila 其他非转移、闪闪发光的液体眼影一样,这款配方具有清爽的感觉、平滑的色彩布局和皮肤调理,带来舒适的感觉。

閃亮的白色液體眼影...有秘密。 從白色閃亮面紗開始,神奇地轉化為發光、強有力的粉彩靈感,在蓋子上閃閃發光。 每個故事都有兩面,與 Stila 的欺騙、變革技術相同。 乍一看,這款閃閃發光的液體陰影會變成白色。 但配方包含有彩色內芯的發光顆粒,混合時,會顯示這些內部核心顏色。 就像 Stila 的其他不轉移、閃閃發光的液體眼影一樣,這款配方具有清新的觸感、光滑的配色以及肌膚調節劑,帶來舒適的感覺。

반짝이는 화이트 리퀴드 아이섀도우... 비밀. 화이트 스파클의 베일에서 시작되는 것은 마법처럼 빛나는 파스텔에서 영감을 받은 뚜껑에서 반짝이는 색조로 변합니다. 모든 이야기에는 양면이 있으며 Stila의 속임수, 변형 기술과 동일합니다. 언뜻보기에 이 반짝이는 액체 그림자는 흰색으로 보입니다. 그러나 포뮬러에는 컬러 내부 코어가 있는 발광 입자가 포함되어 있습니다. 혼합 시 내부 코어 색상을 드러냅니다. Stila의 다른 이동 불가, 반짝이는 액체 아이섀도우와 마찬가지로 이 새로운 포뮬러는 상쾌한 느낌, 매끄러운 색상 레이다운, 편안한 느낌을 위한 스킨 컨디셔너를 가지고 있습니다.

✓ Matte Pearl: Matte Pearl is a combination of a matte finish and subtle fleck of glitter leaving a soft satin finish.

✓ Pearlized: A frosty finish without glitter leaving an iridescent and brightening effect to any eye look.

Use Eye Definer with different Trish brushes for different effects.

Consumer confidence had suffered over the years because of its rampant misuse by manufacturers. To address this problem, the German trade association BDIH worked diligently to define the border between natural and conventional personal care products. Manufacturers must submit their nominated products to an independent laboratory for analysis. If the lab results comply with the guidelines, the product receives the BDIH Seal. The BDIH current minimum requirements to receive the BDIH seal of approval follow. The BDIH also recommends compliance with the following supplemental criteria: - full ingredient disclosure - avoidance of genetically-engineered ingredients - environmental responsibility regarding raw materials, manufacturing, and packaging - social responsibility regarding domestic employees and with 3rd World suppliers of raw materials (Fair Trade) 1. Barry M Cosmetics was created in 1982, in London, Great Britain, by Barry Mero.

In the early 80's Barry had a number of retail outlets in London selling beauty and cosmetic products. The fashion was for dramatic, outrageous make-up, however, he found that no one was producing the exciting and vivid colors that his customers really wanted. So, in June 1982, he created the Barry M Cosmetics range.

Barry M soon became a cult name in the field of color cosmetics. Back in those days, if you were a new romantic, a punk or goth, the chances are you would have been using Barry M to make your fashion statement!

Now, many years' later Barry M is now the Britain's leading color cosmetics brand - other big beauty companies may claim to be British but, in fact, very few of them really are!

That's important because, when it comes to having a British heritage and a British eye for color and style, we're proud to be True Brits. And we're proud to offer our customers a unique mix of high quality, cruelty-free, on trend products at affordable prices.

description:
Barry M Cosmetics was created in 1982, in London, Great Britain, by Barry Mero.

In the early 80's Barry had a number of retail outlets in London selling beauty and cosmetic products. The fashion was for dramatic, outrageous make-up, however, he found that no one was producing the exciting and vivid colors that his customers really wanted. So, in June 1982, he created the Barry M Cosmetics range.

Barry M soon became a cult name in the field of color cosmetics. Back in those days, if you were a new romantic, a punk or goth, the chances are you would have been using Barry M to make your fashion statement!

Now, many years' later Barry M is now the Britain's leading color cosmetics brand - other big beauty companies may claim to be British but, in fact, very few of them really are!

That's important because, when it comes to having a British heritage and a British eye for color and style, we're proud to be True Brits. And we're proud to offer our customers a unique mix of high quality, cruelty-free, on trend products at affordable prices.

Barry M Cosmetics was created in 1982, in London, Great Britain, by Barry Mero.

In the early 80's Barry had a number of retail outlets in London selling beauty and cosmetic products. The fashion was for dramatic, outrageous make-up, however, he found that no one was producing the exciting and vivid colors that his customers really wanted. So, in June 1982, he created the Barry M Cosmetics range.

Barry M soon became a cult name in the field of color cosmetics. Back in those days, if you were a new romantic, a punk or goth, the chances are you would have been using Barry M to make your fashion statement!

Now, many years' later Barry M is now the Britain's leading color cosmetics brand - other big beauty companies may claim to be British but, in fact, very few of them really are!

That's important because, when it comes to having a British heritage and a British eye for color and style, we're proud to be True Brits. And we're proud to offer our customers a unique mix of high quality, cruelty-free, on trend products at affordable prices.

Mehron Makeup 已成為專業化妝的領導者超過 90 年。 我們的產品被廣泛用於世界各地的跑道、舞台和電影組。 ​ Mehron Makeup 很榮幸能為我們的三大化妝品提供獨特的專業產品:美容、身體藝術和表演。 自 1927 年起在美國製造。
